issue.title: minimax: a MiniMax Code Desktop data folder moved in its settings gets no switch (magpie writes ~/.minimax)
issue.body: Found while fixing 教父's report on Discord (225d521cd, v0.1.2684). MiniMax Code Desktop lets the user move its data folder in its settings. magpie still writes the switch to ~/.minimax/config.yaml (or $MINIMAX_DATA_DIR), so with a moved folder the switch lands in a file Desktop doesn't read. Not reproduced on a real install; read from the 3.1.10 download. Next step: find where Desktop stores the moved path and read it.

comments.body:
A Desktop data folder moved in its settings gets the switch now: magpie reads where Desktop put it.

**Where Desktop stores the moved path** (the issue's next step; read from the 3.1.10 arm64 mac download, `filecdn.minimax.chat`, sha512 matched against its `latest-mac.yml`, `app.asar` extracted):

- The relocation is Windows-only: `DESKTOP_RELOCATE_LOCAL_RUNTIME_DATA_DIR` (`storage.ipc.js`) and `relocateLocalRuntimeDataDir` both refuse off `win32` (`WINDOWS_ONLY`).
- The chosen parent is kept in the build's own electron-store: `STORE_NAME = isZh ? "minimax-agent-cn-config" : "minimax-agent-config"` (`storage.ipc.js`), written as `<userData>/<STORE_NAME>.json`, under `config.localRuntimeDataParentDir`.
- `userData` is `MiniMax` (China build) or `MiniMax Agent` (overseas) — `app-identity.js`, the homebrew cask's zap list agrees.
- Desktop pins its runtime to the moved folder through `MINIMAX_DATA_DIR`: `local-runtime/data-dir.js`'s `synchronizeLocalRuntimeDataDirEnv` sets it to `<parent>/.minimax`; its own priority is env > config > default.

**Fix**: `MiniMaxDir` (`internal/agent/minimax.go`) reads the two builds' store files (`miniMaxDesktopStores`, under the OS's Electron app-data base) and, while Desktop is installed (`HasApp` — gone, its store is dead state and the default stays), writes the switch at `<parent>/.minimax`. The user's own `MINIMAX_DATA_DIR` still wins over the store, as it does for Desktop's runtime; a WSL distro's place is untouched. `docs/subsystems/agent-wiring.md`'s MiniMax Code Desktop line says the same.

**One deliberate consequence**: the row serves the CLI as well, and with the folder moved the switch lands where Desktop reads it — a plain `mcode` still on `~/.minimax` does not see it. `internal/sessions`' own `MiniMaxDir` (the Sessions listing) also still reads `~/.minimax`; left out of this change (the issue asks about the switch), say the word and it follows.

**Verification** (base `c86fa2a34`, head `f8b369d9f`):

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Red without the fix (`TestMiniMaxDesktopMovedDataDir`, the `miniMaxDesktopDir()` hook out, helpers kept) | `--- FAIL: the moved folder is not read: "…/.minimax"` |
| Green with the fix | `ok`, beside the MiniMax suite (`TestMiniMaxCode`, `TestMiniMaxCodeSync`, `TestMiniMaxCodeDataDir`, `TestMiniMaxDesktopSaysPickInTheApp`, …) |
| `go test ./internal/agent -count=1` | one red, `TestDshACPSettingsGetTheRoute` — the same red on bare `main` on this machine (its 0644 expectation against a 0027 umask), not from this change |
| `gofmt -l`, `go vet -tags nogui`, `go build -tags nogui` (darwin, GOOS=linux, GOOS=windows) | clean / clean / ok |

**Not verified**: a real Windows install that performed a relocation — the store shape is asserted from the 3.1.10 bundle's own code (the reporter also did not reproduce on a real install); the `TestMiniMaxDesktopMovedDataDir` fixtures stand in for the store.

---

**Attribution**: AI-written; I've read the whole diff and the tests pass. Please keep the author (`vincent`) or add `Co-authored-by: vincent <vincent@users.noreply.github.com>`.

**Branch with the commit**: [`fix/4870-minimax-moved-datadir`](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/4870-minimax-moved-datadir) (head `f8b369d9f`).

Desktop's data-dir relocation (3.1.10's storage.ipc.js, Windows only

app-identity.js's and storage.ipc.js's STORE_NAME; the runtime's
MINIMAX_DATA_DIR pinning is local-runtime/data-dir.js's
synchronizeLocalRuntimeDataDirEnv.

+var miniMaxDesktopStores = func() []string {
+	var base string
+	switch runtime.GOOS {
+	case "darwin":
+		home, _ := os.UserHomeDir()
+		base = filepath.Join(home, "Library", "Application Support")
+	case "windows":
+		base = appdir.Getenv("APPDATA")
+	default:
+		if base = appdir.Getenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME"); base == "" {
+			home, _ := os.UserHomeDir()
+			base = filepath.Join(home, ".config")
+		}
+	}
+	if base == "" {
+		return nil
+	}
+	return []string{
+		filepath.Join(base, "MiniMax", "minimax-agent-cn-config.json"),
+		filepath.Join(base, "MiniMax Agent", "minimax-agent-config.json"),
+	}
+}
+
+// miniMaxDesktopDir is the data folder MiniMax Code Desktop moved in its
+// settings (its data-dir relocation, 3.1.10's storage.ipc.js; Windows only
+// there): the localRuntimeDataParentDir its store keeps, whose .minimax its
+// runtime is pinned to through MINIMAX_DATA_DIR — where the switch magpie
+// writes has to land, ~/.minimax being a file Desktop no longer reads
+// (#4870). "" when Desktop says none: not installed (its store is dead
+// state then), no store, or its default still.
+func miniMaxDesktopDir() string {
+	if !(&Agent{ID: "minimax-code"}).HasApp() {
+		return ""
+	}
+	for _, f := range miniMaxDesktopStores() {
+		b, err := os.ReadFile(f)
+		if err != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		var store struct {
+			Config struct {
+				Parent *string `json:"localRuntimeDataParentDir"`
+			} `json:"config"`
+		}
+		if json.Unmarshal(b, &store) != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		if store.Config.Parent == nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		if d := strings.TrimSpace(*store.Config.Parent); d != "" {
+			return filepath.Join(d, ".minimax")
+		}
+	}
+	return ""
+}
+
 func miniMax(home string) *Agent { return miniMaxAt(here(home), MiniMaxDir(home)) }
 
 // miniMaxIn is MiniMax Code's mcode in a WSL distro (see wsl.go): ~/.minimax,
